answer: Bond 100 POA per identity and cap each identity at 1 payout per epoch. A farm of 1,000 identities locks 100,000 POA to earn at most 1,000 payouts, and extra accounts add nothing past the cap, so the summit of the reward curve is flat. Attack cost per payout stays above honest cost at every fleet size measured across 3 epochs. On the mesa of accounts each one is capped the same, and the dashboard paints capped identities saffron to show it.
